subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool get a narrow binary-document warning fallback now, or wait for the broader document parsing/provider-native file architecture?
rationale: Current source still has the token-waste path, but parser-backed extraction and provider-native file forwarding overlap with broader open issues and need product/security ownership decisions.

options.title: Land a narrow read fallback
options.body: Repair or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office reads return a clear unsupported-document message without adding parsers yet.

options.title: Fold into broader document work
options.body: Keep this issue as context for document attachment/provider-native architecture and close or supersede the narrow guard PR.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow read fallback
recommendation.body: Repair or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office reads return a clear unsupported-document message without adding parsers yet.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available routing signal is the historical read-wrapper ownership and params refactor trail around this boundary.
